content:
Aisha: Heads up — found a mismatch between SDK retry snippet and the error-ref for 429s. The Python sample uses exponential backoff but JS uses a private helper; we should align.
Tom: Ack. Where's the exact file? link?
Aisha: github.com/redwood/docs/blob/main/troubleshooting/errors/429.md (around line 45). Snippet shows:
```python
for attempt in range(3):
    time.sleep(2 ** attempt)
    resp = client.generate(...)
```
And JS currently shows:
```js
await retry(3, () => client.generate(...))
```
Tom: Oof. That `retry` helper is internal; docs shouldn't assume it. Suggest we add a language-agnostic backoff pseudocode and two concrete samples (Python + JS explicit).
docs-bot: Assigned to @Tom for first pass, due in 3 days. PR checklist template added: docs-ci/checklist.
Ravi: Also noticed the context-trim guidance isn't linked from the 429 page. We need a short migration blurb: server-side clipper + client-side prompt rewrite. Add SDK snippet for trimming tokens + a tiny token-count heuristic.
Lina: I can do a quick JS trimming snippet. Prefer using tokenizer helper: https://github.com/redwood/tokenizer — is that public?
Aisha: Tokenizer is internal right now. For docs, include a minimal heuristic `countTokens(text)` and say "swap to official tokenizer when available". Keep snippets small.
Sam: QA: include a tiny replayable cURL example that intentionally triggers 429 in sandbox so QA can validate examples in CI.
QA-Bot: tests/smoke/docs-429.test will be enqueued if PR includes `smoke:429` label.
Tom: Plan for the PR:
- remove reference to internal `retry` helper and add explicit backoff snippet
- add language-agnostic pseudocode "Backoff recommendations"
- add Python + JS token-trim samples and a cURL repro
- update error-ref cross-links and add a short note about fallback to compatible model variants
Aisha: Throw the PR link here when ready so I can review phrasing and tone.
Ravi: Edge-case to document: when fallback model reduces max_context (e.g., 8k -> 2k), note what truncation looks like and recommended client steps (prefix-preserving trim, retry with shorter prompt).
Lina: Also update the Console runbook link — per-route latency breakdown link is missing from runbook.
Tom: I'll ping eng-runtime for confirmation on exact fallback semantics. @Ravi can you provide a concrete numeric example to cite?
Ravi: Use 8k -> 2k example. Add: "Clients should detect truncated outputs (incomplete JSON, cut-off sentences) and attempt prefix-preserving trim before retrying."
Sam: Keep code snippets under 12 lines. CI lint will fail otherwise.
Aisha: Sounds good. Tagging docs-ci checklist: tests, smoke label, update TOC.
docs-bot: Reminder: docs style requires a "What to do" then "What happens" layout for error pages — see style guide: https://go.redwood/style/docs
Tom: Opening a DRAFT PR now — github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4992 (DRAFT).
Aisha: Reviewing in an hour. Thanks everyone :rocket:
